title: Permanental Energy of Graphs
summary: For a simple graph $G$ with adjacency matrix $A(G)$, let $π(G,x):=\mathrm{per}(xI-A(G))$ be its permanental polynomial with roots $μ_1,\ldots,μ_n \in \mathbb{C}$, and define the permanental energy $E_{\mathrm{per}}(G):=\sum_{i=1}^n |μ_i|$. We prove a sharp universal lower bound: for every $m$-edge graph $G$, $E_{\mathrm{per}}(G) \ge 2\sqrt{m}$, with equality if and only if $G$ is a star together with isolated vertices. We also prove the general upper bound $E_{\mathrm{per}}(G) \le nρ(G)$, where $ρ(G)$ is the spectral radius, and we study $E_{\mathrm{per}}(G)$ on several graph families.
